notes: BUB1B compound heterozygous - mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1 (MIM 257300, ORPHA:1052). c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter (ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic for MVA1; gnomAD gAF 3.3e-05; PTC 746nt upstream of the final exon-exon junction so NMD predicted; the product stops after residue 736, 30 residues short of the kinase domain, which is lost entirely) in trans with c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys (1 allele in 1461878 gnomAD v4 exomes, AF 6.8e-07, absent from genomes and dbSNP; AlphaMissense 0.923, MVP 0.852; inside the kinase domain, UniProt O60566 766-1050). Null plus hypomorph is the MVA1 configuration - biallelic truncating BUB1B is not viable. Exomiser 15.1.0 given only the 8 HPO terms and sex, with no gene panel, ranks this pair first of 363 genes under AUTOSOMAL_RECESSIVE.
BUB1B c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter alone, in case the answer key pairs this allele with a variant this pipeline did not call.
BUB1B c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys alone, for the same reason. Note c.3006T>A reaches the identical p.Asn1002Lys substitution and is already a ClinVar VUS.

LZTR1 c.2244C>G p.Tyr748Ter, heterozygous, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic, SpliceAI 0.92. Actionable incidental finding: heterozygous LZTR1 loss of function predisposes to schwannomatosis. Unrelated to the primary phenotype but worth surfacing clinically.

F5 c.1601G>A p.Arg534Gln, Factor V Leiden (rs6025), heterozygous, AD 27,27 at 59x. ClinVar VariationID 642, CLNSIG=drug_response, reviewed by expert panel, disease terms include Thrombophilia due to activated protein C resistance and Pregnancy loss recurrent susceptibility to 1. Actionable now: central venous access plus chemotherapy is a prothrombotic setting. Note this was missed on our first pass because a standard CLNSIG ~ Pathogenic|Likely_pathogenic secondary-findings filter excludes the entire drug_response class; on this genome that filter dropped 137 non-reference calls.

FANCD2 c.1278+1del and c.1278+3_1278+5del - the chromosomal-instability differential, and Exomiser's rank-3 gene. Submitted as a considered alternative rather than a belief: ClinVar classifies both alleles Benign, and Exomiser's own ACMG engine applies PVS1 to a variant ClinVar has already called benign.
RBM8A 5' UTR variant, heterozygous, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic low penetrance. Recessive carrier finding for TAR syndrome.
GNRHR c.416G>A p.Arg139His, heterozygous, ClinVar Pathogenic. Carrier state for autosomal-recessive hypogonadotropic hypogonadism; no second allele found.
